description: This PHP file defines a test class `EmployeeWorkShiftModelTest` which extends `KernelTestCase`. The class contains a test method `testToArray` that verifies the `toArray` method of `EmployeeWorkShiftModel` by creating a work shift with start and end times, converting it to an array, and asserting the expected output.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftModelTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeWorkShiftModel, specifically its toArray method.

methods.name: testToArray
methods.description: Tests that the EmployeeWorkShiftModel correctly converts a work shift object to an array with start and end times.
